correctness.rationale: For every integer \(m\ge2\) and real \(0<t\le2\), the Lipschitz halfspaces are exact and each leaf fiber is an interval centered at \(T/2\) and length \(2-|T|\). Fubini gives the exact density; direct integrals give the stated \(v,w\) and every covariance entry. A determinant-one shear yields \(\det=vw^m\). The window limit follows from dominated convergence of \((1-|s|/(2m))^m\), the CLT and exact independence of leaf \(U_i\) from T. Uniform bounds on H and v, plus uniform \(\mathbb E|T|=O(1/m)\), prove \(L\to1/\sqrt{12}\) even for arbitrarily small \(t_m\). The embedded standard-library checker passed 45 exact rational cases; separate convex-hull integration matched 12 complete volume/covariance cases, but the infinite theorem is analytic.

value.rationale: The book graph with variable common-edge length is a natural minimal family having many overlapping triangle constraints. The theorem evaluates all bulk second moments and the GL-invariant isotropic constant for every dimension and admissible real deformation, separates a sharp \(1/m\) hub boundary-layer crossover from independent Gaussian aggregate-leaf fluctuations, and proves a universal cube isotropic limit without any lower parameter bound. This is structurally stronger than existing face counts, vertex contacts, and selected volume product calculations; it provides exact sampling and quantitative benchmarks for random Lipschitz potentials.
